title: Movie Theaters Are Really Popcorn Stores
description:
Movie Theaters Are Really Popcorn Stores.

Sources:
- AMC Q2 2025 results (Motley Fool): https://www.fool.com/data-news/2025/08/11/amc-posts-36-percent-revenue-jump-in-q2
- Theater ticket split and AMC concession margin (Motley Fool via Webull): https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/13963708595160064

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Movie theaters aren't really in the movie business. They're in the popcorn business.
Theaters send roughly half of every ticket sold back to the studio that made the film.

visual.label: of ticket sales go back to the studios

scenes.narration: But they keep all of the snack money. At AMC, guests spent a record 7.95 dollars each on food and drinks in one 2025 quarter.

visual.label: AMC food & drink spend per guest, Q2 2025

scenes.narration: And snacks are cheap to make. AMC's gross margin on food and drinks is around 80 percent.
So the movie gets you through the door, and the popcorn pays the rent. Follow for more.
